summary: 中文：通过本标题专属 Graphic Pack 控制项把 Cemu 的 VSync 目标设为 44 FPS，复现活动 3DS 金手指中两条重复“44 帧”条目的帧率语义；它不改 RPX 指令或 Cemu 全局配置。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Uses a title-scoped Graphic Pack control to set Cemu's VSync target to 44 FPS, reproducing the frame-rate semantic of the two duplicate active 3DS “44 FPS” entries; it patches no RPX instruction and changes no global Cemu setting. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
